remarks: An extraordinary custom estate where timeless elegance, exceptional craftsmanship, and resort-inspired living come together in one of Coto de Caza’s most coveted neighborhoods. Set on an expansive homesite with picturesque mountain and hillside views, 22 Hawthorne Lane offers an exceptional setting for both grand entertaining and everyday luxury. Beautifully upgraded throughout, the residence features gracious gathering spaces, refined finishes, and a spectacular chef’s kitchen designed to be the heart of the home.
